description_en: Queries the time series data of resource consumption for a quota
description_zh: 查看quota资源消耗的时序信息
kebab_example: aliyun maxcompute query-quota-metric --start-time 1735534322 --end-time 1735536322 --metric cpu --strategy max --nickname os_sns_p --sub-quota-nickname os_sns --interval 60 --sub-metric example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryQuotaMetric

parameters.help_en: The start of the time range to query
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间范围：开始时间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间范围：结束时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The name of the metric. Valid values: cpu and memory
parameters.help_zh: 观测指标名称。仅支持cpu和memory
parameters.name: metric

parameters.help_en:
The aggregation strategy for the data. The default value is max. Valid values: max and avg.

Data is collected at one-minute intervals. If you query a long time range, the system may use an interval longer than one minute and aggregate the data. This parameter specifies how the data is aggregated
parameters.help_zh:
数据聚合策略。默认max。仅支持max和avg。

数据的采集频率是1分钟。当查询的时间范围较大时，数据展示的自适应步长会超过1分钟，此时指标会进行聚合。该参数即指定数据的聚合逻辑
parameters.name: strategy

parameters.help_en: The nickname of the level-1 quota. This parameter is required
parameters.name: nickname

parameters.help_en: The nickname of the level-2 quota
parameters.name: sub_quota_nickname

parameters.help_en:
The fixed interval in seconds. If you leave this parameter empty, the system uses an automatic interval policy.

- Automatic interval policy: The interval is 60 seconds for a time range within 6 hours, 300 seconds for a time range within 24 hours, 900 seconds for a time range within 72 hours, and 1,800 seconds for a time range longer than 72 hours.

- Specified interval: Valid values are 60, 300, and 900. The query time range must be within 72 hours
parameters.help_zh:
固定间隔，单位为秒。默认为空，表示使用系统自适应间隔策略。
- 自适应间隔策略：查询时间范围在6小时内时间隔60s，24小时内时300s，72小时内时900s，超过72小时则1800s。
- 指定间隔：仅支持60，300，900。且要求查询间隔在72小时内
parameters.name: interval
